assets.pano_source: World Labs Marble world marble_hifi (photoreal limestone quarry, 360 pano)

scan_transform.order: p_world = scale * (R @ p_gltf) + translation; p_gltf = visual.glb vertex in glTF scene space (node transforms applied, Y up). matrix = same, 4x4 row-major, column vectors.

design_truck.name: Komatsu HD465-7 (HD465-7E0)
design_truck.source: Komatsu HD465-7E0 product page (55 t nominal payload, komatsu.com); RitchieSpecs HD465-7 (overall width 13.92 ft, length 30.67 ft, height 14.42 ft, wheelbase 14.08 ft, 43.5 mph); distributor sheets: 24.00R35 tires, min turning radius 8.5 m, 70 km/h. Clearance diameter and tire OD (~2.2 m for 24.00R35) are estimates - official PDF not retrievable.

references.IC8758: Kaufman & Ault (1977), Design of Surface Mine Haulage Roads - A Manual, USBM IC 8758. https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/8915
references.MSHA: 30 CFR 56.9300 - berms/guardrails at least mid-axle height of the largest self-propelled equipment that usually travels the roadway. https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/30/56.9300
references.Thompson: Thompson, R.J. (2011) Mine haul road design and management: a review of current practice (SME); Thompson, Mining Haul Roads: Theory and Practice (CRC 2019). https://espace.curtin.edu.au/handle/20.500.11937/22673
references.CatHaulRoad: Caterpillar haul road design guidance (2% constant cross-fall, curve widening tables). https://es.scribd.com/doc/52194520/CAT-Haul-Road-Design
references.Ritchie: Modified Ritchie criterion, catch bench width W = 0.2*H + 4.5 m (Ryan & Pryor 2000, SME). https://cnitucson.com/publications/2000_ch3__Catch%20Bench_sme_tr_pp.pdf
references.WV: W. Va. Code R. 38-3-5 haulageways: switchback grade < approach grade and <= 10%. https://www.law.cornell.edu/regulations/west-virginia/W-Va-C-S-R-SS-38-3-5
references.sim: Team simulator spec (desmondzee/mining spec.md): kinematic truck wheelbase 5 m, max steer 30 deg, max speed 8 m/s.
references.Read&Stacey: Read & Stacey (2009) Guidelines for Open Pit Slope Design (CSIRO): bench face 60-75 deg in competent rock, inter-ramp / overall 35-50 deg typical.

design.notes: Scanned terrain (hillside layout): geometry is as-scanned. Roads are least-cost paths on the navgrid with grades above 10% strongly penalised; widths follow the design truck spec. EXCEPTION: ramp_1 (Lower Face - Primary Crusher) is 11.4% sustained over 50 m (max 12.2% over 20 m); ON the haul cycle - terrain allows nothing flatter. EXCEPTION: ramp_3 (Upper Face - Junction 2) is 15.4% sustained over 50 m (max 16.7% over 20 m); ON the haul cycle - terrain allows nothing flatter. Main demo haul cycle: Lower Face (ore_1) -> crusher via ramp_1, max 11.4% sustained.

navgrid_check.method: passable mask (cost > 0) eroded by truck_width/2 + margin; pairs connected 8-way with the corner rule; corridor width = 2 x min centreline clearance to the nearest blocked cell
